name: Split-Conformal Zero Exclusion
note: Ridge regression of the forward h-bar log return on seven standardised technical features, refitted on the older 500 of the trailing 750 bars, with the most recent 250 held out purely as a conformal calibration set. The half-width is the empirical quantile of |residual|/(ATR/close) on that held-out set, so it is distribution-free and scales with volatility. Trades only when the whole interval excludes zero, and the stop is that same calibrated half-width. Miscoverage is swept above the source's 0.05-0.35 band because a seven-feature ridge on five-minute bars forecasts far inside its own residual scale, and at 0.20 the interval straddles zero on every bar.
source: Vovk, Gammerman & Shafer, Algorithmic Learning in a Random World (Springer, 2005); Lei, G'Sell, Rinaldo, Tibshirani & Wasserman (2018) split conformal. Coverage under non-exchangeability: Barber, Candes, Ramdas & Tibshirani, 'Conformal prediction beyond exchangeability'; arXiv:2203.15885. Time-series conformal sets: arXiv:2206.07851.
code:
def family_init(ctx):
    import math
    bars = ctx.bars
    n = len(bars)
    o = [float(b["o"]) for b in bars]
    c = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    hi = [float(b["h"]) for b in bars]
    lo = [float(b["l"]) for b in bars]
    v = [float(b.get("v") or 0.0) for b in bars]

    NF = 7
    H = int(ctx.p.horizon)
    TR = int(ctx.p.train_n)
    CA = int(ctx.p.cal_n)
    RF = int(ctx.p.refit)
    LAM = float(ctx.p.ridge_lam)
    AL = float(ctx.p.alpha)

    # ---- plain-python indicators (family_init cannot index a Series) -----
    atr = [None] * n
    rsi = [None] * n
    ema = [None] * n
    vma = [None] * n
    tr = [None] * n
    for i in range(1, n):
        tr[i] = max(hi[i] - lo[i], abs(hi[i] - c[i - 1]), abs(c[i - 1] - lo[i]))
    a = None
    for i in range(1, n):
        if i < 15:
            continue
        if a is None:
            a = sum(tr[1:15]) / 14.0
        else:
            a = (a * 13.0 + tr[i]) / 14.0
        atr[i] = a
    up = dn = None
    for i in range(1, n):
        d = c[i] - c[i - 1]
        u = d if d > 0 else 0.0
        w = -d if d < 0 else 0.0
        if i < 15:
            continue
        if up is None:
            us = ws = 0.0
            for j in range(1, 15):
                dd = c[j] - c[j - 1]
                us += dd if dd > 0 else 0.0
                ws += -dd if dd < 0 else 0.0
            up, dn = us / 14.0, ws / 14.0
        else:
            up = (up * 13.0 + u) / 14.0
            dn = (dn * 13.0 + w) / 14.0
        rsi[i] = 100.0 if dn <= 0 else 100.0 - 100.0 / (1.0 + up / dn)
    k = 2.0 / 21.0
    e = c[0]
    for i in range(n):
        e = c[i] * k + e * (1.0 - k)
        if i >= 20:
            ema[i] = e
    run = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        run += v[i]
        if i >= 20:
            run -= v[i - 20]
        if i >= 19:
            vma[i] = run / 20.0

    # ---- the feature matrix ---------------------------------------------
    F = [None] * n
    for i in range(n):
        if i < 25 or atr[i] is None or rsi[i] is None or ema[i] is None:
            continue
        av = vma[i]
        if not av or av <= 0 or c[i] <= 0 or atr[i] <= 0 or c[i - 10] <= 0:
            continue
        F[i] = [
            (rsi[i] - 50.0) / 50.0,
            c[i] / c[i - 10] - 1.0,
            (c[i] - ema[i]) / atr[i],
            atr[i] / c[i],
            math.log((v[i] + 1.0) / (av + 1.0)),
            (hi[i] - lo[i]) / atr[i],
            c[i] / c[i - 5] - 1.0,
        ]

    y = [None] * n
    for i in range(n - H):
        if c[i] > 0 and c[i + H] > 0:
            y[i] = math.log(c[i + H] / c[i])

    def solve(A, b, d):
        for col in range(d):
            piv = col
            for rr in range(col + 1, d):
                if abs(A[rr][col]) > abs(A[piv][col]):
                    piv = rr
            if abs(A[piv][col]) < 1e-14:
                return None
            if piv != col:
                A[col], A[piv] = A[piv], A[col]
                b[col], b[piv] = b[piv], b[col]
            pv = A[col][col]
            for rr in range(col + 1, d):
                f = A[rr][col] / pv
                if f == 0.0:
                    continue
                for cc in range(col, d):
                    A[rr][cc] -= f * A[col][cc]
                b[rr] -= f * b[col]
        x = [0.0] * d
        for rr in range(d - 1, -1, -1):
            s = b[rr]
            for cc in range(rr + 1, d):
                s -= A[rr][cc] * x[cc]
            x[rr] = s / A[rr][rr]
        return x

    # ---- walk forward: refit, calibrate, decide -------------------------
    sg = [0] * n
    qu = [None] * n          # the calibrated half-width, as a return
    mu = sd = None
    coef = None
    y0 = 0.0
    qv = None
    last = -10 ** 9
    need = TR + CA + H + 30
    for i in range(n):
        if i >= need and i - last >= RF:
            last = i
            end = i - H                      # last row whose target is known
            rows = [j for j in range(max(0, end - TR - CA), end) if F[j] is not None and y[j] is not None]
            if len(rows) >= (TR + CA) * 0.6:
                ntr = int(len(rows) * TR / float(TR + CA))
                trr = rows[:ntr]
                car = rows[ntr:]
                if len(trr) >= 50 and len(car) >= 30:
                    mu = [0.0] * NF
                    sd = [0.0] * NF
                    for q in range(NF):
                        col = [F[j][q] for j in trr]
                        m1 = sum(col) / len(col)
                        v1 = sum((x - m1) ** 2 for x in col) / len(col)
                        mu[q] = m1
                        sd[q] = math.sqrt(v1) if v1 > 1e-24 else 1.0
                    y0 = sum(y[j] for j in trr) / len(trr)
                    A = [[0.0] * NF for _ in range(NF)]
                    bv = [0.0] * NF
                    for j in trr:
                        z = [(F[j][q] - mu[q]) / sd[q] for q in range(NF)]
                        yy = y[j] - y0
                        for q in range(NF):
                            zq = z[q]
                            Aq = A[q]
                            for w in range(q, NF):
                                Aq[w] += zq * z[w]
                            bv[q] += zq * yy
                    for q in range(NF):
                        for w in range(q):
                            A[q][w] = A[w][q]
                        A[q][q] += LAM
                    coef = solve(A, bv, NF)
                    if coef is not None:
                        sc = []
                        for j in car:
                            z = [(F[j][q] - mu[q]) / sd[q] for q in range(NF)]
                            yh = y0 + sum(coef[q] * z[q] for q in range(NF))
                            u = atr[j] / c[j]
                            if u > 0:
                                sc.append(abs(y[j] - yh) / u)
                        if len(sc) >= 30:
                            sc.sort()
                            m = len(sc)
                            kk = int(math.ceil((m + 1) * (1.0 - AL))) - 1
                            if kk < 0:
                                kk = 0
                            if kk > m - 1:
                                kk = m - 1
                            qv = sc[kk]
                            last = i
        if coef is None or qv is None or F[i] is None or atr[i] is None:
            continue
        z = [(F[i][q] - mu[q]) / sd[q] for q in range(NF)]
        yh = y0 + sum(coef[q] * z[q] for q in range(NF))
        u = atr[i] / c[i]
        w = qv * u
        qu[i] = w
        if yh - w > 0:
            sg[i] = 1
        elif yh + w < 0:
            sg[i] = -1

    # two consecutive straddling bars is the abstain exit
    strd = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        if qu[i] is None:
            strd[i] = 0
        elif sg[i] == 0:
            strd[i] = (strd[i - 1] if i else 0) + 1
    ctx.sg = ctx.series(sg, "conformal_side")
    ctx.qu = ctx.series(qu, "conformal_halfwidth")
    ctx.strd = ctx.series(strd, "straddle_run")


def signal(ctx, i):
    s = ctx.sg[i]
    return int(s) if s else 0


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    if not ctx.positions:
        return False
    p = ctx.positions[0]
    e = p["entry_i"]
    if i - e >= int(ctx.p.horizon):
        return True
    r = ctx.strd[i]
    if r is not None and r >= int(ctx.p.straddle_n):
        return True
    w = ctx.qu[e]
    if w is None:
        return False
    ent = p["entry"]
    move = (ctx.c[i] - ent) / ent if ent else 0.0
    if p["side"] == "short":
        move = -move
    return move <= -w
